newsitem.title: EGYPT: Norwegian foreign minister in Cairo for peace talks.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian foreign minister in Cairo for peace talks.

text.p: Norwegian Foreign Minister Bjoern Tore Godal arrived on Sunday for talks with his Egyptian counterpart Amr Moussa on the crisis in the Middle East peace process.
Godal, whose country brokered the 1993 PLO-Israeli peace pact, told reporters Norway was keen to do all it could to end the current stalemate.
Israel and the Palestinians have not held talks since the Jewish state began to build a settlement in March in Arab East Jerusalem, which Israel seized in the 1967 Middle East war.
